support.channel: GitHub Issues for reproducible non-sensitive defects; private security reporting for vulnerabilities
support.supported_release_window: current main plus the latest tagged release
support.security_review: on reported vulnerability and before production/customer deployment
support.upgrade_policy: security fixes may require an upgrade to a supported release; backup and rollback procedures are required before upgrades

critical.definition: Confirmed vulnerability with plausible impact to confidentiality, integrity or availability of a deployed analytics service or security boundary.

high.definition: Significant security or reliability defect requiring prioritized remediation.

medium.definition: Material defect with bounded security, reliability or functionality impact.

low.definition: Low-impact defect, documentation issue or improvement request.
